description: This file defines a 'RecipeCard' component for a LightningJS application, displaying recipe details such as image, title, and description, with hover and focus interactions.

classes.name: RecipeCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a card for a recipe, showing image, title, description, and handling hover and focus states.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: A computed property returning a truncated version of the recipe description.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles the enter input event, navigating to the recipe detail page.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets the hovered state to true when the component receives focus.

methods.name: unfocus
methods.description: Sets the hovered state to false when the component loses focus.
